newsitem.title: USA: American Craft founder to be president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: American Craft founder to be president/CEO.

text.p: Peter W.H. Bordeaux, founder and chairman of American Craft Brewery International Inc, will join the company as president and chief executive officer, the company said Thursday.
Bordeaux, 48, will continue to serve the board as chairman, it said.

Bordeaux is leaving Sazerac Co Inc, as president and chief executive of Sazerac Co Inc to focus fully in managing American Craft, which he and other investors formed in 1994 to establish micro-breweries outside the United States, it said.
American Brewery, which turned public in September, opened its first micro-brewery, South China Brewing Co, in Hong Kong in July 1995.
The company has plans to build 20 additional micro-breweries abroad by the end of 1998.
In the brewing industry, micro-breweries are those that produce less than 15,000 barrels a year of "handcrafted" beers.
